answers.question: Arlanda C (`740000556`): withheld: OSM joins no footway to the platforms and tags no entrance
answers.answer: Partly answered. The station is underground, directly under SkyCity between Terminals 4 and 5, with one platform and two tracks (Wikipedia). Passengers pass turnstile gates between the station and SkyCity, where the station fee (130 SEK) is checked (AIAB, Swedavia). OSM has the two platform areas, long escalators (w487787886/7), one lift (n4802014315) and three entrance nodes with fee validators. They are just not joined together. The owner is Arlandabanan Infrastructure AB and the station is run by A-Train AB, not Swedavia or Jernhusen.

open: Arlanda C is underground: platforms, lifts and levels are not visible to the laser and Jernhusen has no Arlanda C page; Swedavia/A-Train pages were not read in this pass.

No published plan of Arlanda C found (Swedavia's train page links none, its SkyCity page could not be fetched, and SL/UL publish no station map). Platform-level layout, lift position and number of escalator banks are unconfirmed beyond OSM.
Arlanda Express does not stop at Arlanda C; it uses Arlanda Södra (T2-4) and Arlanda Norra (T5). Arlanda Express information therefore does not describe this station.
Track numbers at Arlanda C: not given by any source read.
Station counter opening hours: not published on the pages read.
